{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute the proportion of responders by sex
prop_females = df[df['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()

# Print only the final value to be reported (in percent, rounded to 2 decimals)
print(f"{difference_percent:.2f}")"}
